name: Qibla Finder
description: A free online Qibla finder that calculates the bearing to the Kaaba from your location and points to it on a live compass dial in the browser.
longDescription: Qibla Finder answers one question in one tap: which way is the Qibla from where you stand? Allow location access, hold the phone flat, and the page computes the great-circle bearing from your coordinates to the Kaaba and shows it on a rotating dial with the bearing in degrees. If the compass sensor is unavailable the bearing still appears, so a map or a landmark can be used instead; if location is blocked the page says so plainly rather than guessing silently. Coordinates are used for the calculation on the device and are never stored.
pricingDetails: Free — no sign-up, no usage limit, no paid tier. Location is used for the bearing only.
features: Qibla bearing in degrees, computed from your coordinates to the Kaaba
Rotating compass dial with a marker that holds the Qibla direction
Clear status line for GPS, approximate location, blocked permission and missing compass
Bearing stays readable even when the orientation sensor is not available
Fullscreen dial for reading the direction at arm's length
No install, no account; coordinates are not stored or uploaded
useCases: Finding the prayer direction in a hotel room, an office or an airport
Checking the Qibla in an unfamiliar city before laying out a prayer space
Confirming a prayer mat's orientation in a new home
Teaching the bearing concept with a live dial instead of a static map
